name: Vegetable Kolhapuri
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (cauliflower, carrot, beans, peas)
1 tbsp coriander seeds and 3 dried red chillies
1 tsp each cumin seeds and ginger-garlic paste
½ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Dry-roast the coriander seeds, chillies and coconut for 2 minutes and grind with a little water to a paste.
Heat the oil and cook the onion with ginger-garlic paste for 6 minutes. Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Kolhapuri paste and turmeric and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the vegetables and 1½ cups water and simmer for 12 minutes. Add the tofu for the last 4 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, salt and coriander.
note: A fiery Maharashtrian curry; reduce the red chillies to make it milder.
